```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse) 
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
BLM <- read_csv("blm_colorado_3.csv")

BLM <- BLM %>%
  rename(Address1 = `Address_1`,
         Address2 = `Address_2`,
         ZipCode = `Zip_Code`,
         PhoneNumber = `Phone_Number`,
         PICKNICKING = `PICNICkING`,
         DescriptionCharacterLength = `Description_Length`,
         DescriptionLengthWords = `Description_Length_Words`,
         DirectionCharacterLength = `Direction_Length`,
         DirectionLengthWords = `Direction_Length_Words`)

print(BLM)
BLM
```

### Map Stuff

```{r}
library(sp)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)

df <- BLM

# Create point dataframe
points_df <- data.frame(
  lng = df$Longitude,
  lat = df$Latitude,
  names = df$BLM_Name)

# Convert the data frame to a spatial points data frame
points_sdf <- st_as_sf(
  points_df,
  coords = c("lng", "lat"),
  crs = 4326)

# Plot the points on a map
mapview(points_sdf, label = points_sdf$names)

```
